mu_name_from: OpenMU Version075 Items/Weapons.cs:141 names group 4, index 6 the Chaos Nature Bow; _enum.h:1575 MODEL_CHAOS_NATURE_BOW = MODEL_BOW + 6, loaded from Item/Bow07.bmd (ZzzOpenData.cpp loads MODEL_BOW + i from Bow{i+1}), and mu.db's row (code 2054) agrees.
why_this_one: The Chaos Machine's Chaos Weapon recipe makes one of the three Chaos weapons (MixMgr.cpp:689, :1002); none of them drops (dropsFromMonsters false in the call), so without a mesh the recipe had nothing to make (2026-10-02).
stance_from: PLAYER_STOP_BOW 8 and PLAYER_WALK_BOW 21: CharacterManager.cpp:71 counts MODEL_BOW through MODEL_CHAOS_NATURE_BOW as bows, and ZzzCharacter.cpp's stance switch sends BOWTYPE_BOW to PLAYER_STOP_BOW.
fires_from: ZzzEffectMagicSkill.cpp:244: `case MODEL_CHAOS_NATURE_BOW: CreateEffect(MODEL_ARROW_NATURE, ...)`. MODEL_ARROW_NATURE is not built (src/game/fx/arrow.h says so), so this throws the wooden arrow, as Arrows::modelFor already sends every bow-group number below 8.
sheet_from: Data/Item/bow77.OZJ (128x64: green lacquered limbs, silver and gold fittings, two pale green gems), decoded from MuMain; bow01.OZJ and bow05.ozt were already in the tree from the other bows. The .bmd names bow77.jpg on 285 triangles, bow01.jpg on 10 (the nocked arrow) and bow05.tga on 3 (the string card). The bow07.OZJ beside it in Data/Item is not what this model names.
glow_note: MuMain draws this bow transparent, as the Bluewing Crossbow. ItemObjectAttribute (ZzzObject.cpp:5242-5246): `case MODEL_CHAOS_NATURE_BOW` with the Bluewing and Aquagold: BlendMesh = -2, BlendMeshLight = sin(WorldTime*0.004)*0.3 + 0.7, and BMD::RenderMesh (ZzzBMD.cpp:1509, `blendMeshIndex <= -2`) draws every mesh added -- the whole bow, its nocked arrow and string, is a breathing additive ghost, so all three sheets are glows here. Not here: the green BITMAP_SHINY+1 glints MU puts on its six `light` bones when held (ZzzCharacter.cpp:7036-7041), a client effect.
material_note: No baked material: MU draws every mesh added (see glow_note), so the bow ships as glow parts on MU's raw sheets. The islands below are what islands.py measured; their materials go unused.
release_from: Key 4 of this rig's six (the other bows carry seven): Bone10, the second root carrying the arrow and the string, runs -46.6, -23.4, -8.2, +4.4 through keys 0 to 3 and then -54.5 on key 4, and the four limb bones (Bone02, Bone04, Bone06, Bone08) bend to 0.13-0.30 through key 3 and come back to within 0.01 on key 4 -- the Tiger Bow's tracks to the decimal, and the loose. 4/6.
muzzle_from: Measured, and it comes out the Tiger Bow's. Bone10 is at (0, -6.173, -46.594) with no parent and Bone11 at (0, 0.326, 64.829) hanging off it; the arrow is the same seven vertices on bow01, all bound to Bone10. In the model's axes (x, z, -y) the bone is at (0, -46.59, 6.17) and the arrow's point at (1.05, -57.29, 6.46): (+1.05, -10.70, +0.29). Bone10 minus Bone11 is down the shaft toward the point. The release is not folded in, for the reason Bow02.json's muzzle_offset_from gives.
